reason: The cloud lies across the jet, so their encounter should show how the narrow stream disturbs surrounding gas.
expectation: I expect the jet to shock and heat the cloud, perhaps spreading its influence outward.

alternatives.reason: Following the jet through thin gas also seems relevant, but the cloud encounter looks more directly tied to the first goal.

effect: The jet has heated and fragmented the cloud; I can now follow its interaction with surrounding gas.
reaction: The loss of the cloud's immediate star-forming potential is a striking consequence.
reason: Combining the broken cloud with surrounding gas should follow how the disturbance spreads.
expectation: I expect the hot cloud to transfer energy or motion to the surrounding gas, broadening the disturbance.

alternatives.reason: Following the jet through thin gas also seems useful, but I want to continue the cloud encounter first.

effect: The expanding broken cloud formed a wide hot cavity, completing the first goal.
reaction: The contrast between the narrow jet and the broad cavity is striking.
reason: This is the only available gameplay action and should follow the jet farther outward.
expectation: I expect the jet to travel through or affect the thin gas, though its eventual effect is uncertain.

effect: The jet has inflated a broad bubble, which can now interact with the cold clouds.
reaction: The bubble offers another clear contrast with the narrow stream.
reason: This is the only available gameplay action and should advance the remaining goal about cold gas.
expectation: I expect the expanding bubble to push the cold clouds outward, though whether they remain bound to the galaxy is uncertain.

effect: The bubble carried dense clouds outward while their interiors remained cold; their eventual fate is still unknown.
reaction: It's interesting that cold clouds can survive within a hot outflow.
reason: Following the clouds to the galaxies' outer reaches directly addresses whether they are lost.
expectation: I expect to learn whether the outward-moving clouds remain bound or escape, though either outcome seems possible.

alternatives.reason: The interaction with thin gas could also affect the clouds, but their fate at the outer reaches seems more directly relevant.

effect: The clouds stayed bound and began falling back, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The outward flow becoming a later inward flow was a satisfying turn.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds outward and back was most worthwhile: it connected their survival in a hot flow with their eventual return.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the jet through thin gas was less engaging as a decision because it was the only available action, though the resulting bubble was informative.

surprise.text: The dense clouds could remain cold while carried outward by the expanding flow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless; the offered combinations followed the jet and its effects, though some choices were forced.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be interested to see what the returning cold clouds do next, although several forced choices made this chapter less engaging as a game.
